body: respondents No. 8, 16 and 21, which is taken on record. After arguing the matter at some length, learned counsel for the applicant does not press instant Criminal Misc. Application and submits that he will avail remedy by filing Direct Complaint before the court having jurisdiction. Consequently, instant Criminal Misc. Application is dismissed as not pressed alongwith listed pending application, leaving the applicant to avail such remedy. JUDGE “Saleem”
